# Finly — Complete Architecture & Reference

Finly is an open-source, self-hosted personal finance and wealth management application. It offers a privacy-first alternative to cloud-based aggregators such as Finary, Bankin, Mint, or Linxo.

## Philosophy & Core Principles

1. 100% Data Sovereignty: All financial records, banking credentials, and analytics remain strictly on the user's device or self-hosted server.
2. Direct Bank Integration: Bank synchronization happens directly from the user's IP to their financial institution using Woob, with zero intermediate third-party servers.
3. High Performance: Zero network latency for dashboard analytics, instant page loads powered by local SQLite queries and Next.js static and client rendering.
4. Open and Accessible: MIT licensed, fully transparent codebase, zero subscriptions.

## Supported Platforms

- Windows: Native standalone installer (Setup.exe) and standalone portable binary.
- macOS: Apple Disk Image (.dmg) and universal portable archive supporting Apple Silicon and Intel.
- Linux: Debian/Ubuntu package (.deb) and portable tarball (.tar.gz).
- Docker: Production multi-container setup with Docker Compose.

## Key Capabilities

- Net Worth Dashboard: Multi-currency and multi-asset breakdown (checking, savings, crypto, real estate, brokerage).
- Transaction Stream: Real-time search, filtering, custom tagging, and automatic rule-based categorization.
- Expense Analytics: Spending heatmaps, category breakdown charts, recurring subscription detection.
- Budgeting Engine: Zero-based envelope budgeting with rollover tracking.
- Liquidity & Cashflow: Cash balance projection and upcoming bill forecasts.
- Privacy Vault: AES-256 Fernet symmetric encryption for all bank credentials.

## Deployment & Setup

### Quick Docker Setup
```bash
git clone https://github.com/louislefo/Finly.git
cd Finly
docker compose up -d --build
```
Access UI: http://localhost:3000
API Docs: http://localhost:8000/docs
